subject: Hosted API capacity upshift, billing cadence, and contract path
messages:
From: Liz Harmon <liz@capitolcommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: James Lee <james.lee@capitolcommerce.com>, procurement@capitolcommerce.com
Date: 2027-04-08T09:17:00Z
Subject: Request to increase hosted API commit for Q3 launch

Hi Dylan —

We have a major marketing & product push scheduled the week of July 12 and preliminary load tests show we’ll exceed our current hosted commit by ~3.5x for a 4–6 week window. Can you share what an uplift looks like for us if we: 1) double our monthly commit to 2M tokens/month for the next 12 months (annualized), and 2) add a temporary burst cushion for July/Aug?

Two specific asks:
- Can you outline the tiered per-token rates for that volume and any step discounts for annualized commits?
- What’s the invoicing cadence if we agree to an annualized uplift but only ramp in July? We prefer consolidated monthly invoices and interested in 30–60 day net terms.

I attached our recent usage export so you can model (usage_report_Q1.csv).

Thanks —
Liz
Liz Harmon
Head of Product, Capitol Commerce
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Liz Harmon <liz@capitolcommerce.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-09T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted API commit for Q3 launch

Liz — thanks for the data, that helps a lot. I modeled a couple of paths and attached a proposed amendment with tiered pricing and an ops timeline (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf). High level:

- Option A (Annualized commit): 2M tokens/mo committed for 12 months. Unit price = $0.0008/token (10% off list at current bands).
- Option B (Phased annualized): 1.25M tokens/mo for 6 months, then 2M tokens/mo for remaining 6 months; blended pricing with step discount when the 2M threshold is hit.
- Burst pocket: temporary burst credit pool for July — 500k extra tokens that will be invoiced at the overage rate unless consumed as a one-time add-on purchase.

Invoicing cadence: we can do consolidated monthly invoices. Standard is net 30; we can consider net 60 for annualized deals but would need approval from finance.

Operational/ops notes:
- We’ll need an amendment signed to lock the commit and pricing.
- Recommended start date: July 1 to fully cover the July ramp. If you want July 12 start we can prorate June.
- We’ll set up a short canary week and a KV/prefix cache configuration to help reduce immediate token spend during the first week.

Attachments: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf, redlines.docx (will send a separate follow-up with any legal notes).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm target commit and whether you want annualized discount applied.
2) Procurement to confirm PO timing and terms (net 30 vs net 60).
3) We’ll route the amendment through legal and send DocuSign link.

If useful I can jump on a 30-minute call this week to walk the numbers — what’s your availability?

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: James Lee <james.lee@capitolcommerce.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, Liz Harmon <liz@capitolcommerce.com>
Cc: procurement@capitolcommerce.com
Date: 2027-04-12T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted API commit for Q3 launch

Dylan — appreciate the quick modeling. A few procurement items before we route to finance: 

1) Can Redwood accept a PO with net 60 payment terms for the first invoice? Our fiscal calendar and vendor enrollment process requires 60 days on large annualized contracts.
2) We’ll need a SOC 2 Type 2 attestation and a short data-retention statement included in the amendment.
3) For the burst cushion: if the burst is not consumed in July, can the credits be shifted later in the year or are they forfeited?

Attached is a draft PO for your visibility (capitol_purchase_order_draft.pdf).

Thanks —
James
James Lee
Head of Procurement, Capitol Commerce
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Lee <james.lee@capitolcommerce.com>, Liz Harmon <liz@capitolcommerce.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-15T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted API commit for Q3 launch

James / Liz — looping in finance/legal context so we can resolve the procurement asks quickly. Quick answers: 

- Net terms: We can offer net 60 for this transaction pending approvals; finance has flagged that we require the annualized commit and a signed amendment before granting net 60. If we get a signed amendment by May 2, finance is comfortable with net 60 for the first 90 days.
- SOC 2 / data retention: We can include a short attestation paragraph and reference our SOC 2 report; I’ll add the standard clause to the amendment. Dylan — please attach the SOC 2 link and the exact retention verbiage to the DocuSign packet.
- Burst credits: we can allow a one-time 30-day carry-forward on unused July burst credits to be used by end of Q4. After that they expire. That’s our internal ops compromise to avoid over-reserving capacity.

Pricing concession: leadership approved a 10% discount on the unit price if Capitol Commerce signs the 12-month annualized commit by May 15. This is reflected in the attached amendment v1.

Dylan — please update the amendment with the net 60 clause, SOC 2 reference, and the 30-day carry-forward language; then send the DocuSign link and include the HubSpot record for tracking.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Liz Harmon <liz@capitolcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Lee <james.lee@capitolcommerce.com>, procurement@capitolcommerce.com
Date: 2027-04-19T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted API commit for Q3 launch

Marissa / Dylan — this all sounds good. We’ll aim to have internal sign-offs by May 6 and target the July 1 start (prorate June if needed). Please send the updated amendment and DocuSign link; procurement will attach the PO once the amendment is in place. Also please include the SOC 2 redacted report link in the DocuSign packet.

Action items for Redwood:
- Updated amendment with net 60 clause and data retention language.
- SOC 2 reference + link in packet.
- Final DocuSign URL and expected effective date (we prefer July 1).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked.

Best,
Liz
Head of Product, Capitol Commerce
